title: The merge tool posts a review record after each review round
why: Follow-up of step review-rounds-rework. Lesson 1 of 4 from lane priority-vs-merge-order (relayed 04:04 CST Nov 14, lane's own read, unchecked by triage): post the tool-printed review record right after each passing round. Triage sorts it here, not on fail-round-needs-record-before-push (coordinator's pick, 04:05): this step's title is "the merge tool posts a review record after each review round", which covers the PASS case; the FAIL-round step is a push guard for one case. Titles read, fit not proven; the coordinator may overrule. Sighting 04:17 CST Nov 14 (lane test-helper-has-a-home, tool outputs it quoted, relayed by the coordinator 04:16; unchecked by triage): once a PR head moves, `merge --review-record --head <old head>` exits 1 ("the pull request head is <new>, not the reviewed <old> ... No override lifts this refusal"), and `--fix-check <old>` exits 2 ("the reviewed head must be the Head of the newest earlier review log on this pull request ... (no earlier record exists)"). A round that passed at head A but was not recorded before the next push can get neither a record nor a fix check; the only route is a fresh round at the live head. Cost: a fresh round. Second case of lesson 1 (the first: the #3378 and #3250 lanes). Filed here, where triage sorted lesson 1 of the closed step lane-four-lessons-unfiled; the coordinator asked for it on that step, which is closed. Cases 04:21 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 04:21, relayed; unchecked by triage): the old-head record refusal has now hit four lanes: #328, #3233 (earlier), #3395 (04:12) and #3389 (local-autonomy-equals-cloud, head 93df5839b684, draft). #3389 opened its PR after round 3 and never posted a record at the reviewed head 6f367b532; six lint-fix commits later the tool refuses both the record at 6f367b532 and `--fix-check`. Route the coordinator gave: a fresh round 1 at the live head. The coordinator asks to raise this to a build step ahead of the queue: it is already doing (lane in the lane field), so triage leaves the order to the coordinator and the owner's ruling own-ready-by-priority; the case count is the evidence for the priority. Case that is new here: a lane that opens a PR after its reviews cannot get a record for the reviewed head at all. Route that worked 04:58 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 04:57, relayed; mailaudit #324): rounds 1 (haiku) and 2 (sonnet) were recorded at 7daa55fc, then main was merged in, then a fresh sonnet fix check was accepted with `--head e00b874f --fix-check 7daa55fc`. So a record posted at the reviewed head before the next push lets a later base merge carry a fix check; the refusals above hit only lanes that never posted the record. One more case where main moved under a recorded head, and the tool handled it.
note: Named by lane review-rounds-rework in PR #1552 (coordinator, 16:33 CST Nov 7). Done check: each round leaves a merge-tool record on the PR. Sighting (lane stall-watch-quiet-lint, PR #1823, 01:47 CST Nov 8): no review record after rounds 1 and 2, so `merge --review-record --fix-check` could not attach a fix check, and a full round 3 ran in its place. Sighting (lane agent-report-shas-resolve, [ended:lane:-agent-report-shas-resolve], PR #1864, 03:29 CST Nov 8): the lane opened its draft PR only after review round 2, so the merge tool had no PR to hold a record for round 2's head (decision pr-review-record wants one per reviewed head), and round 3 ran in place of a fix check. Folded in: the lane's suggested step lane-pr-before-review (a lane opens its draft PR before review round 1, by a guard on reviewer spawns or a line in the lane brief template); a record after each round needs that PR to exist. Sighting (timing-tests lane, 07:22 CST Nov 8): no record was posted after the round-1 and round-2 FAILs on #1147, so the fix-check route was refused; the lane asks for a reminder in the review flow after each FAIL round. Sightings (coordinator, sent 15:24 CST Nov 8): #2266, #2296 and #2297 each posted one record at the end, naming rounds that read older heads; each record is void and needs a fresh chain. Correction (coordinator, sent 15:28 CST Nov 8): it withdrew its voids on #2224, #2296, #2235 and #2265; decision pr-review-record allows a record that lists rounds on older heads. The 15:24 CST sightings above (#2266, #2296, #2297 void) stand withdrawn too. Follow-up: step record-rounds-name-own-head. Sighting (lane guard-relative-write-escape, [ended:lane-guard-relative-write-escape], 16:14 CST Nov 8; it proposed step review-record-each-round, folded here): a lane ran rounds and fix checks on #2234 without posting `merge --review-record` at each reviewed head, so no valid record can be built after the fact and #2234 missed batch 66. Fix shape it named: the reviewer brief or a stop check requires the record at each review head. Kept doing on: #1678 open draft (record-after-each-round-build) (triage reader agent, Explore Sonnet audit, read of origin/main 0e6509a96, 06:03 CST Nov 10). Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was [ended:lane:-record-after-each-round]). Lane fan-code-handoffs carries it and #1678 (coordinator 07:35 CST Nov 12).
